limitations: The unchanged physical_state_hash and save format omit the new transient arrival witness. It can change future coupling admission/body response without changing native cell transport; equal native physical hashes do not establish complete coupled replay state.
Sampled path and accumulated angular travel are observed response, not calibrated material weight, momentum or static load.
Event partition by witness presence classifies the whole accepted event in that observation; fresh and persistent components may be mixed.
Only completed original campaign receipts are included. Partial reports are not full-population acceptance.
